gumroad_title: MARABOUT - Oriental & Afro Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Kora, Oud, Ney, Pads
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (kora, balafon, oud, ney, zurna, choir, dark pad and sub) and 70 factory presets.
about: MARABOUT, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
59 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode for chords and layered melodies, with up to 16 voices; the other 11, leads and subs, load in Mono mode.
Built for Afro-trap and Afrobeat melodies, Gnawa and Middle Eastern-flavored loops, cinematic pads and drones, and voodoo-style 808 subs.

features.d: Kora, balafon, oud, ney, zurna, choir, dark pad and sub voodoo, all generated in real time.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from harps and mallets to dark drones and voodoo subs.
Five detuned saws through vowel filters; TONE sweeps a, o, u, i.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated ADSR.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.

includes: MARABOUT plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .mbpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
